prayerExcerpt.en-US: St. Julius was a Roman, and chosen Pope on the 6th of February in 337.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: São Júlio era romano, e foi escolhido Papa no dia 6 de fevereiro de 337.

meta.face: A Roman of about sixty with a warm olive complexion and a face that WIDENS DOWNWARD — NARROW temples and a moderate, rounded forehead above a BROAD, BONY, ANGULAR JAW whose corners stand out clearly under the beard, so the face reads as a trapezoid, broad at the base; a long, straight nose ending in a slightly FULL, rounded tip, SMALL, ROUND, dark-brown eyes set CLOSE together under single, smoothly ARCHED dark brows, flat cheeks, a WIDE, THIN-LIPPED, straight mouth; dark-brown hair cut short in a round clerical tonsure, a SHORT, close-trimmed dark-brown beard greying at the chin that follows the angle of the jaw; the gaze steady and direct, toward us.
meta.basis: The twelfth-century apse mosaic of Santa Maria in Trastevere (Wikipedia's lead image) (the file named for Julius on Wikipedia) shows him tonsured, with a short dark beard, holding a book; the card keeps the tonsure and beard. That church, whose apse mosaic dates from 1130–1143, was rebuilt on a larger scale by Julius in 340 (Wikipedia), so the background is a plain early brick basilica in Trastevere. The book tells his defence of Athanasius at the Roman synod, his letter to the Eusebian bishops and the Council of Sardica; its engraving shows him seated at a desk writing, a monk at the door. The face widening to a bony, angular jaw is our choice.
